From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Security walkthrough — compressed window & evidence handoff

Hi Priya —

Appreciate the context and the evidence index — this is helpful. We can absolutely support a compressed cadence; we've been piloting a compact format that pairs a 45-minute technical control walkthrough with a separate 30-minute evidence-transfer session the same day. That often hits the right balance between context and handoff.

Suggested approach (pick one):
1) Single-day compact: 45m walkthrough + 30m evidence handoff (same bridge). Preferred: Wed 17 Jun 2026 09:00–10:15 PDT (we allocate a 15m buffer).
2) Morning walkthrough + afternoon drop: 45m walkthrough (09:00–09:45 PDT) + 30m evidence handoff at 14:00–14:30 PDT (useful if your team needs time to stage uploads).
3) Full consolidated 75m block: Thu 18 Jun 2026 10:00–11:15 PDT (if you prefer one continuous session).

Evidence transfer options we support:
- Secure, temporary S3 upload link (pre-signed) — easiest for large binary artifacts.
- Shared Google Drive folder with restricted domain access (we prefer links with expiration).
- Direct SFTP drop (if your security team requires it).

To streamline downstream review we propose an "evidence passport" — a single PDF that maps items in your CSV to the canonical artifact location, owner, retention note, and a short excerpt of the artifact (if applicable). I've attached a template (redwood-evidence-passport-template.pdf) that we use; if you fill the mapping we can handle ingestion and tagging on our side before the handoff session.

For the call, our plan: Marcus — DPA/agreements + runbook overview; Kimberly — network & infra controls and identity; Olga — logging, retention, and audit evidence. We can include a member of our Reliability team if you expect questions on KV/infra residency.

If any of these slots work, we'll send a calendar invite and a temporary upload link. Also: please confirm whether pentest-eng@pentestco.com should be on the whole bridge or just the evidence handoff.

Attachments:
- redwood-evidence-passport-template.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

Best,
Marcus Lin
Staff Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
